title: Import your Twitter follows to Mastodon
description: Find the people you followed on Twitter who are now on Mastodon and follow them again. Your archive is read in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

title: Post to Mastodon and Bluesky at the same time
description: Write once and post to Mastodon and Bluesky together. Sign in with either account, connect the other, and try it from a simple composer in your browser.

title: Mastodon analytics for your account
description: Free analytics for your Mastodon account: top posts, engagement per post, estimated reach, when you post, who you talk to most and how many followers are active.

title: Find your GitHub friends on Mastodon
description: Find the people you follow on GitHub who are on Mastodon, using the links in their profiles first, and follow them in a click.

prerenderCheck.heading: Find your GitHub friends on Mastodon

title: Schedule Mastodon posts in advance
description: Schedule Mastodon posts in advance: write several at once, space them out daily or hourly, and your Mastodon server publishes them on time with the tab closed.

title: Find your Bluesky follows on Mastodon
description: Find the people you follow on Bluesky who are also on Mastodon, from the handles in their bios first, and follow them there in a click.

prerenderCheck.heading: Find your Bluesky follows on Mastodon

title: Find your Mastodon follows on Bluesky
description: Find the people you follow on Mastodon who are also on Bluesky, from the handles in their bios first, and follow them there in a click.

prerenderCheck.heading: Find your Mastodon follows on Bluesky

title: Turn off boosts on Mastodon for everyone you follow
description: Hide boosts from everyone you follow on Mastodon at once, without unfollowing anyone. See how many change first, and turn them back on any time.

title: Find your phone contacts on Mastodon
description: Find the people in your phone contacts or Google Contacts who are on Mastodon. Your contacts stay in your browser; you follow each match yourself.

prerenderCheck.heading: Find your phone contacts on Mastodon

title: Find the RSS feeds of everyone you follow on Mastodon
description: Turn the websites in your Mastodon follows' profiles into one OPML file of their blogs and RSS feeds, for any feed reader. A Mawkingbird Plus feature.

prerenderCheck.heading: Find the blogs and RSS feeds of everyone you follow

title: Mute Amnesty and Block Amnesty: unmute and unblock everyone on Mastodon
description: Unmute or unblock every account on Mastodon at once with Mute Amnesty and Block Amnesty. See the count and back up your list first.

prerenderCheck.heading: Unmute and unblock everyone on Mastodon

title: How to be (pseudo)anonymous on Mastodon
description: Make your Mastodon account hard to link to you: hide your follows, leave search and suggestions, and check what gives you away, in one step.
